title: Second Meeting with Noe

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Come talk to me darling. Ever since I retired I'm in terrible danger of becoming maudlin and it does nothing for my complexion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come talk to me darling. Ever since I retired I'm in terrible danger of becoming maudlin and it does nothing for my complexion.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: A little. I'm glad you're keeping her spirit alive. What I do miss are the drinks. We had the best menu in Lowtown, new cocktails every week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A little. I'm glad you're keeping her spirit alive. What I do miss are the drinks. We had the best menu in Lowtown, new cocktails every week.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Frankly? It's like a Spire debutante caught in the rain: insipid and tasteless.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Frankly? It's like a Spire debutante caught in the rain: insipid and tasteless.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: You’ll always get that from me, darling. Too many people sugarcoat their words in this city, so you don’t taste the betrayal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’ll always get that from me, darling. Too many people sugarcoat their words in this city, so you don’t taste the betrayal.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: You asked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You asked.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Well, you can do something about your menu for a start. Where’s the spice? The glamour? The cocktails so strong that when you fall off your chair it takes three days to land?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you can do something about your menu for a start. Where’s the spice? The glamour? The cocktails so strong that when you fall off your chair it takes three days to land?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Would you call yourself a cocktail connoisseur? Or an enthusiastic amateur? Some of my recipes can be a little tricky to make.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you call yourself a cocktail connoisseur? Or an enthusiastic amateur? Some of my recipes can be a little tricky to make.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: A regular Icarus. Watch out for those wings. Perhaps you can handle one of the old Lily specials. It’s called an Ultra 64.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A regular Icarus. Watch out for those wings. Perhaps you can handle one of the old Lily specials. It’s called an Ultra 64.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: No harm in learning to strut before you fly. I’ll give you a recipe for one of the Lily classics. The Strawberry Stinger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No harm in learning to strut before you fly. I’ll give you a recipe for one of the Lily classics. The Strawberry Stinger.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Of course you do. I’ll transmit the ingredients list to your Automata. Have one on me, won't you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course you do. I’ll transmit the ingredients list to your Automata. Have one on me, won't you?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Not really. I see you're better suited to the cut-throat world of business than I was. But I do miss the drinks. We had the best menu in Lowtown, new cocktails every week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really. I see you're better suited to the cut-throat world of business than I was. But I do miss the drinks. We had the best menu in Lowtown, new cocktails every week.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Yes. And too late.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. And too late.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Hard lessons are the most valuable lessons, darling!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hard lessons are the most valuable lessons, darling!

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: The LUZ will love it. The ingredients are vodka, brandy, HOVA fuel, liquid nitrogen and lime.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The LUZ will love it. The ingredients are vodka, brandy, HOVA fuel, liquid nitrogen and lime.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Sweet, simple, effective at loosening Lims. The main ingredients are gin, strawberries, ginger and chili.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sweet, simple, effective at loosening Lims. The main ingredients are gin, strawberries, ginger and chili.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you still thinking about your bar?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you still thinking about your bar?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you still thinking about your bar?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you still thinking about your bar?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, can't stop right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, can't stop right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you think of my menu?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think of my menu?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you think of my menu?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you think of my menu?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ouch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks for the honesty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for the honesty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then how can I improve things around here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then how can I improve things around here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then how can I improve things around here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then how can I improve things around here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you recommend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you recommend?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Connoisseur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Connoisseur.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Amateur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Amateur.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like the sound of that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like the sound of that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like the sound of that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like the sound of that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you learned that the hard way?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you learned that the hard way?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like you learned that the hard way?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like you learned that the hard way?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would I take advice from someone who failed?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would I take advice from someone who failed?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would I take advice from someone who failed?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would I take advice from someone who failed?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could I add one of your cocktail recipes to the menu?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could I add one of your cocktail recipes to the menu?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Could I add one of your cocktail recipes to the menu?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Could I add one of your cocktail recipes to the menu?
